segments.text: Shall we put the film on, or do you want tea first?
Tea first. Ellis, can you read this out? The captions are on.
I can read it on the phone. It shows who is talking, which helps.
Good. Then nobody has to repeat the jokes.
Nobody repeats them in this house. They are too bad.

recordings.title: Asking at the station in Rome

segments.text: The train to Florence leaves from platform 7, in about ten minutes.

original.text: Il treno per Firenze parte dal binario 7, tra circa dieci minuti.

segments.text: Thank you. Do I need to stamp the ticket?
No, it is already valid. Have a good trip.

original.text: No, è già valido. Buon viaggio.

segments.text: Today we look at how the printing press changed who could read.
Take one tablet with food, twice a day.
